brief:
Rapper Macklemore kicked off a new tour on Thursday night with an explicit pro-Palestine statement, Al Jazeera English reported. He told the audience at the opening show that "being human is not complicated" while promoting his Free Palestine tour.

The artist has previously expressed support for Palestinian causes through his music and public statements. The tour name reflects his continued advocacy on the issue.
dek: Macklemore says ‘being human is not complicated’ as he kicked off his Free Palestine tour on Thursday night.
title: Macklemore launches tour with pro-Palestine message
